name: AutoGen
summary: Microsoft's multi-agent conversation framework, strongest when agents genuinely need to talk to each other.
description:
AutoGen's model of the world is a group chat: agents with tools and personas exchange messages until the task resolves, which is a good fit for tasks with no fixed pipeline — research loops, adversarial review, code-and-test cycles. The newer rewrite separated the core event-driven runtime from the high-level API and the Studio front end, and that split matters if you are evaluating maturity.

Multi-agent conversation is expensive and hard to make deterministic, so it is overkill for most production features that a single model with tools handles better. Choose it when you specifically want independent agents to disagree, and budget for the token cost of the disagreement.
